newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algiers' CPI rose 0.5 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Algiers' CPI rose 0.5 pct in November.

text.p: Algeria's capital consumer price index rose 0.5 percent in November 1996 compared with 1.6 percent in the same period last year, the official National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
The official APS news agency quoted the office as saying Algiers consumer index "is nearly the same than the national index and it serves as its reference."
It said the increase was attributed to "the rise in costs of farm products -- 3.2 percent-- while industrial food products fell one percent from the previous month."
The office said that from January to May, consumer price in Algiers and its suburbs have increased by 14 percent, which represents a 1.27 percent monthly rise but started to drop in June.
It added that these figures confirm the decline of the annual rate of inflation in Algiers which stands at 19 percent for the eleven months of 1996 from 30.6 percent the same period last year.
